mechanisms.name: Per-neuron atlas and population selection
mechanisms.observed_mechanism: Store/query per-neuron chi bindings; match-score and grandurun/greedy selection are prescribed decision authorities.

refs.anchor: **This is the architectural correction that distinguishes Loom-Neuron from production.** Each neuron carries her OWN chi-atlas (`ChiAtlas` instance per `LoomNeuron`). She binds what HER krimelack transduced. She queries her own bindings on recall. She does not have access to other neurons' bindings except via coupling spikes propagating activity to her.

Physics: clockless habituation. Match-score from chi-atlas raises dead-zone barrier — Δ_eff = Δ_base + match_score. The medium remembers what it has been doing. Repeated identical input exhausts the response. Novelty escapes through the lifted barrier when match_score is low.
